name: LaTeX AI Workbench
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      LATEX_AI_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Select validation
        id: plan
        run: python3 -B .latex-ai/workbench.py plan --github-output "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Check changed files and policy
        run: python3 -B .latex-ai/workbench.py validate --files-only
      - name: Test workbench
        if: steps.plan.outputs.check_unit == 'true'
        run: make -C workbench test
      - name: Test compiler portability
        if: steps.plan.outputs.check_portability == 'true'
        uses: xu-cheng/texlive-action@22c04326a5d855880f9d39bb955138bf11c6df80 # v3
        with:
          texlive_version: 2026
          os: debian
          run: |
            apt-get update -qq
            apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 make
            make -C workbench portability
      - name: Check project Make rules
        id: project_check
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.plan.outcome == 'success' && steps.plan.outputs.check_full == 'true' && steps.plan.outputs.project_check == 'true' }}
        uses: xu-cheng/texlive-action@22c04326a5d855880f9d39bb955138bf11c6df80 # v3
        with:
          texlive_version: 2026
          os: debian
          run: |
            apt-get update -qq
            apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 make
            make check
            make latex-ai-pdf-artifact DOC=paper
            make latex-ai-pdf-artifact DOC=derivation
            make latex-ai-pdf-artifact DOC=notebook
      - name: Check document paper
        id: document_0
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.plan.outcome == 'success' && contains(fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.document_ids), 'paper') && steps.plan.outputs.check_full == 'true' && steps.plan.outputs.project_check != 'true' }}
        uses: xu-cheng/texlive-action@22c04326a5d855880f9d39bb955138bf11c6df80 # v3
        with:
          texlive_version: 2026
          os: debian
          run: |
            apt-get update -qq
            apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 make
            make latex-ai-document-check DOC=paper
            make latex-ai-pdf-artifact DOC=paper
      - name: Upload PDF paper
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.plan.outcome == 'success' && contains(fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.document_ids), 'paper') && (steps.project_check.outcome == 'success' || steps.document_0.outcome == 'success') }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        with:
          name: paper
          path: .latex-ai/artifacts/documents/paper/document.pdf
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Check document derivation
        id: document_1
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.plan.outcome == 'success' && contains(fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.document_ids), 'derivation') && steps.plan.outputs.check_full == 'true' && steps.plan.outputs.project_check != 'true' }}
        uses: xu-cheng/texlive-action@22c04326a5d855880f9d39bb955138bf11c6df80 # v3
        with:
          texlive_version: 2026
          os: debian
          run: |
            apt-get update -qq
            apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 make
            make latex-ai-document-check DOC=derivation
            make latex-ai-pdf-artifact DOC=derivation
      - name: Upload PDF derivation
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.plan.outcome == 'success' && contains(fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.document_ids), 'derivation') && (steps.project_check.outcome == 'success' || steps.document_1.outcome == 'success') }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        with:
          name: derivation
          path: .latex-ai/artifacts/documents/derivation/document.pdf
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Check document notebook
        id: document_2
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.plan.outcome == 'success' && contains(fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.document_ids), 'notebook') && steps.plan.outputs.check_full == 'true' && steps.plan.outputs.project_check != 'true' }}
        uses: xu-cheng/texlive-action@22c04326a5d855880f9d39bb955138bf11c6df80 # v3
        with:
          texlive_version: 2026
          os: debian
          run: |
            apt-get update -qq
            apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 make
            make latex-ai-document-check DOC=notebook
            make latex-ai-pdf-artifact DOC=notebook
      - name: Upload PDF notebook
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.plan.outcome == 'success' && contains(fromJSON(steps.plan.outputs.document_ids), 'notebook') && (steps.project_check.outcome == 'success' || steps.document_2.outcome == 'success') }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        with:
          name: notebook
          path: .latex-ai/artifacts/documents/notebook/document.pdf
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
